ITEM 1 | Four to five cubes/wedges of bright yellow, firm-looking solid pieces with slightly irregular edges and a smooth, slightly glossy surface, roughly 2-3 cm each, clustered at the lower left of the plate; no visible browning or char | 90
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-cream, crumbly, finely granular mass with small curds and clumps, matte surface with some slight golden-brown tinge at edges, not glossy or flowing, spread across the lower right of the plate covering roughly 10x8 cm | 85
